qa_pairs.question: How do users request Turing GPU nodes on the Graham cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: Users request Turing GPU nodes on the Graham cluster by specifying `--gres=gpu:t4:2` in their job submission script, which in this example, requests two T4 cards per node.

qa_pairs.question: How do users request Ampere GPU nodes on the Graham cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: Users request Ampere GPU nodes on the Graham cluster by specifying either `--gres=gpu:a100:2` or `--gres=gpu:a5000:2` in their job submission script, which requests two Ampere cards per node of the specified type.

qa_pairs.question: What is the operational status of the Graham cluster starting January 13, 2025, and what is the reason for this change?
qa_pairs.answer: Starting January 13, 2025, the Graham cluster will operate at approximately 25% capacity until the new Nibi system comes online.
